rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something splendid or exceptionally good.

example.english: The desserts at this restaurant are excellent.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 tim4 ban2 hou2 zing3

rows.note: Use this especially when praising how well a person, performance, plan, or solution works.

example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 gaai2 sik1 hou2 dim6 wo3

rows.note: Choose this when highlighting outstanding quality, ability, or performance in a more measured way.

example.english: Their performance in this speech was excellent.
example.traditional: 佢今次演講嘅表現出色。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 jin2 gong2 ge3 biu2 jin6 ceot1 sik1

rows.note: Use this specifically for something of notably high quality, especially a product, service, or piece of work.

example.english: This coat is of excellent quality, and it isn’t expensive.
example.traditional: 呢件外套做工高質，價錢又唔貴。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 zou6 gung1 gou1 zat1 gaa3 cin2 jau6 m4 gwai3
